name: Jellyfin
description: Free media server for your NAS: movies, series, music and photos with posters, subtitles and Chromecast. Hardware transcoding uses the NAS's Intel/AMD GPU (VAAPI/QuickSync) or an NVIDIA card when EthOS can pass one through, so 4K playback stays smooth without pinning the CPU. Data lives in a package folder that survives updates.
author: SyncHot
changelog: 1.0.0: first release — Jellyfin 10.11.11 pinned, config in a package folder that survives updates, the library mounted read-only from /home, /mnt and /media, and hardware transcoding through the host GPU (VAAPI/QuickSync via /dev/dri, NVENC when the Docker nvidia runtime is configured). Falls back to software transcoding on a NAS without a GPU instead of failing to install.
